judge_notes: Four distinct behavioural assays identified: intermittent ethanol drinking, intermittent sucrose drinking, short-term food/water intake, and ICSS. All three candidates converged on this set.
Added d-amphetamine as a second dosing entry (used as positive control in the ICSS assay) — candidates omitted it.

B4 (ethological): adopted 'No' (gpt-glm modal interpretation) since the assays measured intake volumes/preferences rather than scoring natural behavioural acts; drinking volume per the rubric is not an ethological behaviour score.
D3 for ICSS: scored 15+ given the crossover design with 4 drug treatments separated by ≥7 days plus daily basal sessions — many recording days for this single assay across the testing phase.

D3 for drinking assays: scored 15+ because the paper reports 4 weeks of baseline drinking (4 days/week ≈ 16 days) plus treatment week and follow-up week, all generating recorded intake data for the same assay.
ICSS session duration scored 0 with low confidence — the paper does not explicitly state the duration of a threshold session.
sex_dependent set to n/a throughout (only male mice were used).
